name: codex-accounts-bugteam
description: Optional BugTeam one-hour account purchase and balance-pool import integration for Codex Accounts Manager.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.cjs && node -e "for (const file of ['src/managerApi.cjs','src/api/client.cjs','src/core/product.cjs','src/core/sub2.cjs','src/storage.cjs','src/ui/panel.cjs','src/ui/integration.cjs']) require('./' + file)"
scripts.package:check: npm run check && npm run audit:portability && node scripts/check-package.cjs
scripts.package: npm test && npm run package:check && node scripts/prepare-dist.cjs && npx --no-install vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/codex-accounts-bugteam.vsix
